notes: world-editor (Docs/WorldEditor.md). active: the world edit set every match loads (Content/Data/WorldEdits/<name>.json; "" = the whole town). The map layout editor's WORLD tab (RouteEditor.cmd, B) writes it on SAVE; cire.WorldEdit <name>|off switches live. mirror / ghosts: the WORLD tab's defaults. protectWords: pieces whose name contains one of these are guarded (protected on a monster path, a warning elsewhere). protectPad: cm around a piece's footprint for the marker checks. boxSelectMaxSize: box select skips pieces larger than this (cm).
